# Ānāpānapabba

*Breathing*

### 1 Kāyānupassanā

*Contemplation of the body*

### 1.1 Kāyānupassanāānāpānapabba

*Contemplation of the body: the section on breathing*

**Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati?**

**Literal:** How-and then, bhikkhus, [does] a-bhikkhu in-the-body body-contemplating dwell?  
**Faithful:** And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu dwell contemplating the body as a body?  

| Word | Analysis & Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`kathañca`** | `(sandhi)` [*kathaṁ* (adv) how + *ca* (ind) and] and how?; **[kathaṁ + ca]** |
| **`pana`** | `(ind)` moreover, and so, but; **[pana]** |
| **`bhikkhave`** | `(masc voc pl)` bhikkhus, monks; **[√bhikkh + u + ave]** |
| **`bhikkhu`** | `(masc nom sg)` bhikkhu, monk; **[√bhikkh + u]** |
| **`kāye`** | `(masc loc sg)` in the body; **[√ci > ki > kay + a]** |
| **`kāyānupassī`** | `(adj masc nom sg comp)` contemplating the body, observing the body; **[kāya + anupassī]** |
| ↳ **`kāy'`** | `(masc comp)` [*kāya* before a vowel] body; **[√ci > ki > kay + a]** |
| ↳ **`anupassī`** | `(adj masc nom sg)` contemplating, observing; **[anu + √dis > passa + ī]** |
| **`viharati`** | `(3rd sg pres act indic)` dwells, lives; **[vi + √har + a + ti]** |

*DN 22:2.1–2.15*
